name: Average Table Time and Production Time
query:
WITH invoice_production_times AS (
    SELECT
        pos_invoice.name AS invoice_id,
        AVG(formatted_kot.production_time) AS avg_production_time_seconds
    FROM
        `tabPOS Invoice` AS pos_invoice
    JOIN
        (SELECT
            kot.*,
             DATE(kot.date) AS formatted_kot_date
         FROM
             `tabURY KOT` AS kot
        WHERE kot.order_status = 'Served'
        ) AS formatted_kot
   
    ON pos_invoice.name = formatted_kot.invoice
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
    WHERE 
    (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND pos_invoice.`posting_date` = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(pos_invoice.`posting_date`, pos_invoice.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(pos_invoice.`posting_date`, pos_invoice.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND pos_invoice.`posting_date` = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
    )
    AND pos_invoice.branch = %(branch)s
)

SELECT
    DATE(posting_date) AS Date,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            TIME_TO_SEC(
                ADDTIME('00:00:00', total_spend_time)
            )
        )
    ) /60 AS `Average Spend Time`,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_production_time_seconds),3) AS `Average Production Time`
FROM `tabPOS Invoice`
LEFT JOIN invoice_production_times
ON `tabPOS Invoice`.name = invoice_production_times.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
    rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
)
WHERE 
(
    ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND `tabPOS Invoice`.posting_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
    OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(`tabPOS Invoice`.posting_date, `tabPOS Invoice`.posting_time) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(`tabPOS Invoice`.posting_date, `tabPOS Invoice`.posting_time) >= TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
    OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND `tabPOS Invoice`.posting_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
)
AND `tabPOS Invoice`.branch = %(branch)s
